description: Take a point-in-time snapshot of a site's served files, a restore point the user can restore in the VibeDeploy dashboard within the plan's restore window. Served content does not change, but retention cleanup may remove older snapshots. Container data is not included. Requires an owner or admin team role. NO_VOLUME means the site was never deployed.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for this snapshot.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: create_snapshot

snapshotName.description: The name of the snapshot that was created.

title: Create a manual snapshot (restore point) for a site
